verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents a REST API, an official Node.js SDK and a Postman collection, but nothing in the evidence shows an official command-line interface. An SDK and API are developer building blocks, not the CLI itself, so they earn no credit. An official CLI is a fair question for a SaaS accounting platform, so the axis applies and absence of evidence is "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
